title: 第 11 章 这剑法是你的了第 12 章 好大的茶味啊
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 那两个师妹站在原地这会儿整个人都傻了。
她们瞪大眼睛并看着躺在地上的陆云，已经半天都说不出话来了。
要知道陆云师兄可是金丹大圆满啊，而且是整个外门数一数二的存在难道就这么被陈默一掌打飞了？
“陈默你怎么敢打伤陆云师兄！”其中一个师妹结结巴巴的开口道。
“你知道陆云师兄是谁吗他可是大长老的弟子，你打伤他长老不会饶了你的到时候你就等着被逐出宗门吧。”
这时陆瑶也回过神来，于是便咬着牙看陈默眼神里也充满了怨恨。
“陈默你完了，你打伤我哥大长老一定不会放过你的到时候你就等死吧！”
然而陈默却没有理会这几个女人，甚至看都没看她们一眼直接朝陆云走去。
那陆云躺在地上正挣扎着想要站起来，在看到陈默走过来以后他的脸色变得更加难看了。
“你要干什么。”他盯着陈默开口道。
“陈默我警告你别乱来，你要是敢动我，我师父不会放过你的。”
只见陈默走到他面前在停下脚步以后便居高临下的看着他，随后就抬起脚并踩在了陆云的手上。
然后陆云就惨叫一声，刚刚还想把手抽回来，可突然发现陈默的脚沉得可怕他根本动弹不得。
“陈默你这个混账。”陆云咬着牙能注意到他额头上的忽然青筋暴起。
“快把你的脚拿开。”
然而陈默看着他而且脸上没有任何表情，“你不是要让我跪下来给你磕头吗？”
“现在呢还要我继续给你跪吗？”
此刻的陆云咬着牙没有说话，但他的手指被陈默这么一踩疼得他冷汗直冒。
“陈默你会后悔的。”
只听陈默说完以后就抬起脚并踹在陆云的身上。
那陆云的身体直接飞了出去在地上滚了好几圈才停下来，而且衣服上全是灰尘和血迹看起来狼狈极了。
两个师妹看到这一幕脸色无比的难看。
“陆云师兄！”
此刻的陆云并没有说话，只不过盯着陈默的眼神里充满了阴狠。
陈默没有理会她们而且转身直接朝藏经阁的方向走去。
一脸狼狈的陆云被两个师妹扶着慢慢站了起来，只见他的右手肿的厉害而且手指头都变了形。
这会儿盯着陈默离开的方向咬着牙在心里想着，陈默你给我等着这件事不会就这么算了。
这件事他一定会让师父替他做主。
要知道他师父可是大长老金丹大圆满之上的强者，收拾陈默这个废物还不是轻而易举。
“我定要让师父替我出这口气。”
“没错，大长老看到陆云师兄被打成这样一定不会放过陈默的。”
“陈默这次死定了。”另一个师妹说道。
于是陆瑶点了点头便扶着陆云朝大长老的住处走去。
片刻后陈默就走进了藏经阁的大门。
这藏经阁是一个三层高的楼阁，第一层外门弟子可以进但是到了第二层的话就需要内门弟子的身份才能进。
至于第三层则只有长老和宗主才能进。
只见他走进第一层之后就看到里面摆满了书架，而且书架上还放着各种各样的功法和法术。
此刻在角落里有一个老者正坐在椅子上，只见他闭着眼睛像是睡着。
那老者穿着一身灰色长袍脸上也有不少的皱纹，陈默看了他一眼没有多说话。
这个老者是看守藏经阁的人，至于他是什么实力没人知道。
但那老者似乎感觉到了他的目光，于是这才睁开眼睛看了他一眼。
刚刚这老者在心里想着，没想到这个年轻人有点实力。
content_en:
The two junior sisters were stunned as they stood there.
They stared at Lu Yun lying on the ground with wide eyes, speechless for a long time.
You must know that Senior Brother Lu Yun is the Golden Elixir Perfection, and is one of the best in the entire outer sect. Could it be that he was knocked away by Chen Mo's palm?
"Chen Mo, how dare you hurt Senior Brother Lu Yun!" One of the Junior Sisters stammered.
"Do you know who Senior Brother Lu Yun is? He is a disciple of the Great Elder. If you hurt him, the Elder will not spare you. Then you can wait to be expelled from the sect."
At this time, Lu Yao also came to her senses, so she gritted her teeth and looked at Chen Mo with resentment in her eyes.
"Chen Mo, you're done. If you hurt my brother, the elder will definitely not let you go. Then you just wait to die!"
However, Chen Mo ignored these women and walked directly towards Lu Yun without even looking at them.
Lu Yun was lying on the ground and struggling to stand up. After seeing Chen Mo coming over, his face became even more ugly.
"What are you going to do?" He stared at Chen Mo and said.
"Chen Mo, I warn you not to act recklessly. If you dare to touch me, my master will not let you go."
Chen Mo walked up to him, stopped and looked at him condescendingly, then raised his foot and stepped on Lu Yun's hand.
"Ah..."
Then Lu Yun screamed, and just now he wanted to pull his hand back, but suddenly found that Chen Mo's feet were so heavy that he couldn't move at all.
"Chen Mo, you bastard." Lu Yun gritted his teeth and noticed the sudden veins on his forehead.
"Get your feet off."
However, Chen Mo looked at him without any expression on his face, "Don't you want me to kneel down and kowtow to you?"
"Do you still want me to continue to kneel to you now?"
At this moment, Lu Yun gritted his teeth and said nothing, but his finger was so painful when Chen Mo stepped on it that he broke into a cold sweat.
"Chen Mo, you will regret it."
After Chen Mo finished speaking, he raised his foot and kicked Lu Yun.
Lu Yun's body flew directly out and rolled on the ground several times before stopping. Moreover, his clothes were covered with dust and blood, and he looked extremely embarrassed.
The two junior sisters looked extremely ugly when they saw this scene.
"Senior Brother Lu Yun!"
Lu Yun didn't speak at this moment, but stared at Chen Mo with eyes filled with viciousness.
Chen Mo ignored them and turned around and walked directly in the direction of the Sutra Pavilion.
Lu Yun, who looked embarrassed, was slowly stood up with the help of two junior sisters. His right hand was swollen badly and his fingers were deformed.
At this moment, I stared at the direction Chen Mo was leaving, gritted my teeth and thought to myself, Chen Mo, if you just wait for me, this matter won't just be let go.
He will definitely let Master make the decision for him.
You must know that his master is a powerful person above the Great Elder's Golden Core, so it is not easy to deal with Chen Mo, a waste.
"I must let Master say this for me."
"That's right, the Great Elder will definitely not let Chen Mo go when he sees Senior Brother Lu Yun being beaten like this."
"Chen Mo is dead this time." Another junior sister said.
So Lu Yao nodded and helped Lu Yun walk towards the elder's residence.
…
After a while, Chen Mo walked into the door of the Sutra Pavilion.
This Sutra Pavilion is a three-story pavilion. Outer disciples can enter on the first floor, but if you reach the second floor, you need to be an inner disciple to enter.
As for the third level, only elders and clan leaders can enter.
After he walked into the first floor, he saw that it was filled with bookshelves, and there were also various exercises and spells on the bookshelves.
At this moment, there was an old man sitting on a chair in the corner. He had his eyes closed and seemed to be asleep.
The old man was wearing a gray robe and had many wrinkles on his face. Chen Mo glanced at him and said nothing.
This old man is the person who guards the Sutra Pavilion. No one knows what his strength is.
But the old man seemed to feel his gaze, so he opened his eyes and glanced at him.
The old man was thinking in his heart just now, but he didn't expect that this young man had some strength.
